**P80: the response as the dynamics give.** After P64–P68 landed (`bca9695b`), Ren wrote: "another agent has got this far, maybe merge first and see if there is something to work on" ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-12-merge-first.md)). The AI found an unclaimed further proof in the chapter's section 8 that joins P65: "a comparison in which others respond as the dynamics give, not through a second flow supplied". It is also the next step of P65's record. The AI claimed it on the work board as P80, and the integrator (Universal Metaethical Core) accepted it and placed it after P76. The proposal and the readings are the AI's. P65 (section 87) decides the comparison within the responsive reach but supplies two things: the second flow, and the premise that the rest responds through its registration (`Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration`). This section makes the rest's exchange a law and derives both. `Becoming.Counterfactual` (46 theorems, L4) imports `Becoming.Response`, `Becoming.Mechanism` and `Becoming.Unfolding` and changes no existing module. P69 (`da8f75a7`) landed first. The integrator left the instance theorems of P80 with `Unfolding` to whichever landed second; the AI wrote them as P80b, and the integrator agreed to fold them into this landing (one check, one documentation round). It adds no axiom. The law of exchange, that it reads what has stood, feasibility of the course and finitely many conditions each enter only as hypotheses of the theorems that use them.
- **The counterfactual is fixed by the act.** An exchange law reads, from the history of levels, how much each formation takes from and gives to each condition across each step (`ExchangeLaw`). It reads what has stood when, across step t, it reads only the history up to step t (`ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating`). Take two balanced flows with the same formations present and the same start, in which the part acts alike and the rest follows one law reading what has stood. They have the same levels and the same exchange at every step (`levels_fixed`, `counterfactual_fixed`). So once the law is given, an act has at most one course.
- **It exists exactly where it is feasible.** The law generates a course from the starting levels, the orbit of one determined law on the stage and the history so far (`ExchangeLaw.course`, `ExchangeLaw.history_orbit`). Each formation follows the law in it (`ExchangeLaw.course_follows`). It balances exactly where the law never takes from a condition more than stands and is given (`ExchangeLaw.course_balances_iff`). The counterfactual of an act is the course it generates (`counterfactual_is_course`). Where every formation, the part included, follows one law reading what has stood, a balanced flow is the law's course (`ExchangeLaw.course_unique`). Truncated subtraction is handled by the module's own lemma, not by `Nat.sub_add_cancel`, which depends on propext (`sub_add_back_iff`).
- **P65's response premise follows.** A law reads through a registration when, outside the part, two histories registered alike up to step t give alike at step t (`ExchangeLaw.Through`). Where it does, the rest responds through its registration in any two courses of the law (`ExchangeLaw.Through.responds`). Every law of what has stood reads through registering everything (`ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_all`). The least registration is the law's own sensitivity. A formation's exchange is sensitive to a condition when, at some step, the condition's level makes a difference with the other conditions fixed up to that step (`ExchangeLaw.Sensitive`). With finitely many conditions, listed, and decidable equality of conditions, a law of what has stood reads through every registration that observes what it is sensitive to, so through its sensitivity itself (`ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_of_observed`, `ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive`, by changing one condition at a time, `mixIn_alike`, `alike_of_sensitive_agree`). Conversely, every registration a law reads through holds, with what the formation depends on, each condition its exchange is sensitive to (`ExchangeLaw.Through.registers_of_sensitive`, double-negated; no sensitivity is decided).
- **The comparison as the dynamics give.** For two balanced courses of the law, with the same formations present and a common start, take a law reading through a registration. Any significance covering every formation not beyond the responsive reach drawn through that registration compares the two as the axiom does (`comparison_of_courses`). With finitely many conditions no registration is supplied: the reach is drawn through the law's sensitivity (`comparison_through_sensitivity`). The same holds between the actual course of an act and the feasible course another act generates, with neither the second flow nor the response supplied (`ExchangeLaw.withAct`, `comparison_with_act`).
- **The act is the input of a standard causal model (P68).** The history generated while the part makes a list of moves is a trajectory of the standard model whose input is the part's move, with no noise (`ExchangeLaw.ofMoves`, `ExchangeLaw.course_trajectory`, P68's `inputs`). An act not taken is an intervention: where a run of that model has not taken it before step t, the record does not fix its outcome, and the model does (`ExchangeLaw.act_not_taken`, an instance of `inputs_intervention_unfixed` and `inputs_model_fixes`).
- **The counterfactual as P69's unfolding (P80b).** Where formations and conditions are one kind of relatum, the course is a P69 world (`ExchangeLaw.world`). It balances, and so runs by the law of exchange with its relata's exchanges as moves, exactly where the course is feasible (`ExchangeLaw.world_balances_iff`, `ExchangeLaw.world_exchange_iff`, `ExchangeLaw.worldRun`). `Run.beyond_shown_iff` is a law about P69's `Shown`, for any determined law: the law steps beyond what a run of it shows exactly where it steps at all and the run never takes that move there. Following the integrator, it stays in `Counterfactual`, its only user, and moves to `Unfolding`, name and statement kept, when a second module needs it. So the history of the course's standard model shows a determined law (`Consistent`), and the part's move has a step of the model beyond that history exactly where the history never takes it (`ExchangeLaw.counterfactual_beyond_shown`): what the law adds to the history is exactly its counterfactuals. With the part's move formed by a law on the configuration (`ExchangeLaw.policy`), a run of P69's `closedBy` from the starting levels is the course that act generates (`ExchangeLaw.closedBy_course`), so two such runs agree (`closedBy_runs_agree`).
- **Witness.** In P65's `Loop`, the second's reply is a law: after its own condition falls, it takes two units from the first's condition. The law reads what has stood and only what the second observes (`Loop.replyLaw_nonanticipating`, `Loop.replyLaw_through`). Both flows follow it, so P65's `Loop.responds`, checked there case by case, follows from the law (`Loop.responds_by_law`). Each flow is fixed by the first's act (`Loop.courses_fixed`).

**P77: what listing once commits to.** Under Ren's "move towards 100%", the zero-premise plan's commitment that each relatum is listed once and families are without repetition (`Distinct`) is found out, as P58 did for decidedness. A new core module `Becoming.Listing` (imports `Decidedness`, `Sampling`, `Resolution`), no axiom, no premise, no existing module changed.
- **Listing once is decided identity.** A list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided (`listsOnce_iff_decided`), constructively (`listOnce`), and that it can be is never refuted (`not_not_listsOnce`). The number of relata a list holds is one number and exists exactly then (`Numbers.unique`, `numbers_iff_decided`).
- **Refutations need nothing; sums and counts need it locally.** A law refuting something wherever a list is listed once refutes it with no premise (`not_of_listsOnce`), so the refutation laws hold of families however listed, and dissipation brings every enumerated world to rest (`World.Enumerated.rests`). A step is enclosed exactly where some closed family has decided identity among its members (`Flow.enclosed_iff`); a world is finite exactly where it is enumerated and identity among its relata is decided (`World.finite_iff`). Repetition is not harmless: a sum law fails over a family listing a member twice (`Doubled.needs_once`).
- **The boundary.** Every list over a type can be listed once exactly where identity on the type is decided (`listsOnce_all_iff`). Read through relations, up to indiscernibility, the number of relata of every list of every world is fixed exactly under excluded middle (`World.Indiscernible`, `World.numbers_indiscernible_iff_em`), and names count twice what no relation tells apart (`World.probe_named_apart`).
- **By occurrence.** Read by its occurrences every flow lists what takes part once with no decided identity and keeps its amounts (`Flow.byOccurrence_once`, `Flow.byOccurrence_balances`); occurrences are not followed across steps (`Flow.byOccurrence_uncounted`).

**P78: the step index, re-founded.** Under Ren's "move towards 100%", the zero-premise plan's commitment to a shared discrete index of steps is examined, as P69 examined the starting point. A new core module `Becoming.Order` (imports `Becoming.Sampling` only), no axiom, no premise, no existing module changed. It makes the two moves converse to Sampling's coarser reading: inserting idle steps, and taking two exchanges in the other order.
- **Stuttering.** A world read through a stuttering meets the premises exactly where it meets them (`World.stutter_premises_iff`), its totals over every stretch are those of the stretch read (`stutter_total`), and arising, ceasing and change recur exactly where they recurred (`World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff`). What changes is what is counted per step: with idle steps arbitrarily late nothing is more without end (`Flow.sample_not_more`), and a reserve must double when every step is read twice (`Lapse.reserve_step_relative`).
- **Commutation.** Two consecutive exchanges that sides split can be taken in the other order: balance, dissipation and embodiment hold exactly where they held, and counts and totals over a stretch are kept (`World.commute_laws`, `World.commute_counts`), under any number of such commutations too (`Reorders.laws`, `Reorders.totals`), Mazurkiewicz trace equivalence.
- **What the order carries.** The order registers through dependence and through a shared relatum: in `Crossing` a relatum is active without support in the other order, and in `Arising` a relatum gives before it is active (`Crossing.order_registers`, `Arising.order_registers`).

- **The order as an object (P78b).**
  - A footprint says which relata each exchange touches; where it contains the exchanges, the joins between exchanges generate a strict partial order (`Footprinted.Precedes`).
  - Commuting unjoined exchanges keeps that order up to the renumbering (`Footprinted.reorder_precedes`).
  - Conversely, by constructive bubble sort, the renumberings of a stretch reached so are exactly those keeping it. A world with the same exchanges, footprints and changes in such an order, from the same start, agrees with a reordering at every step (`Footprinted.sorts_iff`, `Footprinted.converse`).
- **What carries (P78b).**
  - Along unjoined commutations, every premise carries both ways (`Footprinted.reorder_premises`).
  - Along any reordering, the counts of arising and ceasing carry (`Reorders.counts`).
  - Commuting joined exchanges breaks activity needing support and only active relata giving (`Crossing.reorders_joined`, `Arising.reorders_joined`).
- **Removing idle steps (P78b).** The world without the idle steps of a stuttering (`World.withoutIdle`) meets every premise exactly where the world does. It has a census exactly where the world does, and the same totals and counts over any stretch (`World.withoutIdle_premises`, `World.withoutIdle_counted`, `World.withoutIdle_totals`).

**P79: the laws of one step are all the laws of one step.** Under Ren's "move towards 100%", completeness in the strong sense, which held for counting only (`tally_iff_counted`), is proved for Locality's laws of one step. A new core module `Becoming.OneStep` (imports `Counting` and `Sampling`), no axiom, no premise, no existing module changed.
- **Exact under each condition.** A pattern (the passages of a family's members, the count of takers, whether something exchanges) is shown by some world exactly when it obeys the law of every step (`OneStep.every_iff`), and on a family balanced on, running down, closed, or both, exactly when it also obeys that condition's law (`OneStep.balance_iff`, `OneStep.runsDown_iff`, `OneStep.closed_iff`, `OneStep.runsDownClosed_iff`); so a property holds of every such step exactly when it holds of every pattern obeying the law (`OneStep.laws`). Across runs on one family the only further law is that what stands after each step stands before the next (`OneStep.Chained`, `OneStep.run_every_iff`).
- **Two laws the spine had not stated.** Something taken has a taker (`Flow.sign_uptake_le_takers`); nothing is taken beyond what stood with what was given (`Flow.BalancesOn.taken_le`). Without the first, the stated laws allow a pattern no world shows (`OneStep.stated_not_realized`); with it they are the whole law for a family running down closed (`OneStep.runsDownClosed_iff_stated`).

- **Givers, capacity and activity (P79b).**
  - Something given has a giver: the givers number at least one wherever anything is given, and at most what is given (`OneStep.Givers`).
  - Running down adds exactly that every giver takes (`Flow.DissipatesOn.renewers_le_takers`).
  - Capacity adds exactly that what is given is at most capacity times the givers (`OneStep.every_capacity_iff`).
  - Activity at the step adds no law (`OneStep.every_active_iff`).
- **Families chosen step by step (P79b).**
  - Where the family may change at each step, no condition, balance and closure join no step to the next (`OneStep.step_every_iff`).
  - Running down joins steps by continuity up to order: at each positive level as many stand after a step as before the next (`OneStep.Continues`, `OneStep.step_runsDown_iff`).

**P82: weighted histories.** Ren asked, of laws that are not determined, whether one can still integrate over their many patterns and loops as with Feynman diagrams, how accurately, with what losses, and whether the theory is sound. The core's laws that are not determined state what is possible, not how much. P82 states what a weighting of steps adds and proves where the sum over histories is exact and where it loses. A new core module `Becoming.Weighted` (L3, imports `Becoming.Capture` and `Becoming.Resolution` for two arithmetic lemmas), no axiom; the weights come with their laws (`Weights`), and each theorem holds for every weighting and listing it names.
- **Exact.** With the moves and configurations listed, the sum over every course of `n` steps of the composed weights is `n` steps of the transfer (`Weights.sum_courses`): exponentially many courses, summed one step at a time. A reading that keeps the laws of the weights can be taken course by course or at the end (`Weights.Hom.transfer`).
- **Possibility is the core's relation.** With possibility weights reading a process's steps, the transfer after `n` steps holds exactly where a trace of `n` moves leads where the end reading holds (`possibility_transfer_iff`); the count of courses is not zero exactly where a course exists (`support`, `counting_transfer_iff`).
- **Integrating out.** What is read through a description after every number of steps depends on the description alone exactly where it does after one step (`Weights.lumped_iff`), the weighted form of `carries_law_iff`; where it does not, the description carries no weighted law (`Lumping.loses`).
- **The losses, each a theorem.** A truncation misses exactly what it drops, and where alternatives only add it bounds the whole from below (`Weights.truncation`, `counting_truncation_le`). With signed counts possible courses can balance, a truncation can mislead, and no reading into possibility that keeps the join of alternatives sees the cancellation (`signed`, `Interference.cancels`, `Interference.truncation_misleads`, `Interference.unseen`). A weighting depending on how one came is not one of steps on the configurations it is given on, and is one on configurations keeping what it needs (`Memory.not_of_steps`, `Memory.of_kept`). Around a loop of two moves the courses double at every step (`Loop.courses_double`).

**P84: transmission, derived or bounded.** `Becoming.Evolution` takes transmission as a premise (`Flow.TransmitsWithin`). Under it, a relatum descending across a step that depends on `c` at its first standing step descends only from relata depending on `c` at the giving step, and needs `c` at most `δ` more. P84 asks whether the premise follows from the core's others. It states the premise as a law of one descent, and proves what derives it and where no derivation reaches. The work is a new core module, `Becoming.Transmission` (L3, imports `Becoming.Premises`), with no axiom.
- **What transmission is.**
  - At one descent, transmission is inheritance together with the need within a bound (`Web.transmits_at_iff`, `Flow.transmitsWithin_iff`). Inheritance means the descendant's dependence at its first standing step was held by the giver at the giving step.
  - Where the descendant held no dependence before it stood, inheritance is exactly the law of forming: a dependence forming at a relatum as it comes to stand is one its giver held (`Web.inheritsAt_iff_forming`).
  - In general, forming and holding make inheritance where the earlier holding is decided. Asked of every descent, that is excluded middle (`split_iff_em`).
- **No new dependence by descent.** Under balance and inheritance, nothing coming to stand depends after the step on a condition nothing taking part depended on (`Flow.no_new_dependence`).
- **The evolution laws, with the premise inside.** The evolution bounds hold at the one descent they use (`Flow.inherited_supported_at`). At a relatum coming to stand they need only some supported giver (`Flow.fromSome_supported`). That form is strictly weaker (`TwoGivers.twofold`).
- **Independent wherever it binds.**
  - Dropping one dependence of the giver changes no level, activity, drawing, need or flow. It keeps every other premise and finiteness, and breaks transmission (`World.drop_but`).
  - So a condition kept by dropping a dependence that implies transmission implies that transmission does not bind (`World.vacuous_of_drop_invariant`).
  - The reading of drawing is such a condition (`World.drawn_not_enough`).
- **What derives it.**
  - With one law requiring dependence, that drawing on `c` is depending on it, the reading gives inheritance (`Flow.inherits_of_drawn`).
  - In a finite world meeting balance, dissipation, embodiment and activity needing support, transmission is exactly inheritance (`World.transmitting_iff_inherits`), so the reading with the law gives transmission (`World.transmitting_of_drawn`).
  - This is not vacuous (`World.bearingHatch_derived`), and each of the two is needed (`World.drawn_and_link_needed`).

The other seven premises only limit dependence; transmission requires the giver's, so any derivation needs a law requiring some dependence to exist.

**§107, P86: feeding across steps, redundancy and reserves.** Reuses feeding-closure, consumption-ends-with-feeders, laws-of-one-step and reserve-defers-ending. The new module `Becoming.Feeding` imports Interdependence (L4), changes no existing definition and states no ethical premise. Earlier giving, continuing standing and later need are relations in one history.

A condition is carried from s to t where it balances throughout the stretch and stands positively after s through t. At positive delay, some nonincreasing following of a positive gift, bounded by the gift and the condition's standing, remains positive exactly where the condition remains positive (`can_stand_iff`, `carriedTo_iff_stands`). A spent intermediate step excludes such a following; a gift exceeding all taking over the stretch suffices regardless of how taking is attributed. Quantities have no origin marks: possible carrying is not identified with an actual material origin.

Same-step feeding is exactly feeding across steps at zero delay. The least formation region closed under feeding across steps contains the old closure; outside it nothing gives to a condition carried to a step at which a member requires it. With no giving retained after its step, the closures agree. Provision exhibits strict inclusion: a parent active at step 0 feeds a young active at step 2 through a store, although it never feeds it at a common step. Formation-level chains do not by themselves give an event path ordered in time.

Under local balance, meeting need m after a step is exactly `m + taken ≤ level + given`, with every-step and finite-stretch versions. These characterize meeting needs, not activity sufficient from support. When givers are supported and none supported gives, the initial stock covers a need at the end exactly while it covers cumulative taking plus that need. Consuming for more steps than the initial level exhibits a supported feeder. With the remaining exchange fixed and a withheld part taking nothing from the condition, the need remains met exactly where the actual level covers the need plus everything that part gave earlier. In Redundant either of two feeders suffices; removing both in a separate flow ends activity within the original bound. Withholding either in the actual flow leaves an admitted level path; withholding both while fixing the consumer's draw leaves no balancing level path. The latter is an impossibility statement, not a dynamically adjusted counterfactual.

Counterreview retains the supplied balance and the distinction between possible and actual carrying. Not derived: the actual following of a gift, the exact criterion for carrying however taking is attributed, a center's representation of its closure, or an event-level temporally ordered closure. Existing reserve-ending laws are reused, not reproved. The two existing records are extended; no new independent result is counted. Core receipt 20261013T091820.375259Z checks 41 module theorems with empty source axiom reports; periphery 20261013T091907.838571Z passes. Original draft evidence remains preserved. The integration has no independent review yet; physical correspondence and the readings remain the AI's.

**Persistence through dormancy and identity fixed by relations (P87, §108).** The same unfolding can retain a dependence or reserve while a formation is inactive. This extends `identity-across-steps`, reusing its re-identification and continuation relations, the existing census laws and P69's exchange likeness. It does not create a second result for the same question. Claude's source and task are preserved in the P87 package; the integrated evidence is `Becoming.Persistence` (71 theorems, consolidated receipt `20261013T091820.375259Z` with empty axiom reports; periphery `20261013T091907.838571Z`). The preservation alone was not verification.

- **Continuity through holding.** For any predicate `h`, `Web.persisting h` reads activity through holding. Where activity is contained in `h`, arising while subsequently active is exactly activity-arising from not holding, and ceasing has the corresponding form; waking from holding is not holding-arising. Keeping the names of what holds fixes one name over a held stretch. Activity and dependence contained in `h` separately recover the old continuity conditions. The renewing/consuming class equivalences require the chosen formation to hold at **every** step. Hibernation shows this stronger than two-way activity and tenure continuity; Dormancy still permits a join where nothing holds. Dependence and reserve give the seed different endings, so choosing `h` remains a reading.
- **The census is an instance.** `Web.persisting_census` uses a census and four explicit decisions: held activity, `Continues`, `Continued` and `R`. Without splits, ceasing recurring needs arising recurring. Without merges and with the census eventually bounded by a fixed number, the converse holds. Both ends use holding. Sleeper has activity-ceasings recurring while holding-arising never occurs; conditions making a mixed reading valid remain open.
- **What conservation fixes.** `World.balanced_reidentify_iff`, without an additional hypothesis, characterizes the re-identifications under which a world balances as the one-to-one continuations lying within `World.Conserves`. In a balanced world, this relation is equality of standing after the step, linked to P69's existing `Alike` through `exchange_alike_iff`. Keeping and breaking are invariant. With decidable equality, `fixed_iff`, `arises_fixed_iff` and `ceases_fixed_iff` characterize what every balance-preserving naming fixes; necessity exchanges two relata with equal standing. Where standing after **every** step distinguishes **all** relata, every balanced re-identification is a fixed renaming and classes are fixed. Distinguishing only the active relata at one end gives the respective no-split or no-merge property, not that stronger conclusion.
- **The counterexamples stay.** Shuttle fixes its sides' identities, while reading the moving unit as one formation breaks its balance. The two-kind reading `World.ofRoles` gives formations zero standing; Lineage and Hibernation then permit different namings preserving per-step relations and balance but changing arising or class. They do not claim to preserve every possible additional cross-time relation. Conservation as the continuation, and activity-or-dependence as holding, are the AI's readings awaiting Ren.
- **Counterreview and boundary.** No law derives the physical necessity of balance; hypotheses and representation remain disclosed. Keeping/breaking invariance is not undermining invariance. Classes and tenure under general splitting/merging continuations, undermining under conservation, sufficient mixed-census conditions and the actual holding relation remain open, alongside a fuller material, informational or organizational account of identity. The integration text has author counterreview, not an independent scientific review; this does not complete the whole zero-substantive-axiom target.

**P88: the order of exchanges—normal form, census and least footprint (§109).** Begin with which relations change across a step of one unfolding. P78/P78b reads the order of exchanges from the relata their footprints touch. This integration reuses `only-the-order-of-change-registers`, `exchanges-commute-unless-joined` and `order-of-exchanges-is-the-invariant`. The preserved `Becoming.OrderNormal` imports only `Becoming.Order`; the world, exchange and order definitions are reused. No new proof is added during takeover. The distinct additions are the named lexicographic normal form and the least containing footprint; the census result advances the existing commutation record. P78's converse, restated as `rearranges_iff`, is a reused connection rather than another independent result.

An arrangement `Reindexes S m π σ` supplies a finite stretch and its inverse, with exchanges named by natural numbers in that stretch. For a symmetric joining relation, two arrangements are connected by adjacent unjoined commutations exactly where they orient every joined pair alike (`rearranges_iff`), without decidability. To select a canonical representative, `DecidesApart` supplies Boolean decisions of **not being joined** for distinct exchanges in the stretch. `normalSteps` brings forward the least-named exchange currently free to move there. Two arrangements are reachable exactly where their normal forms agree throughout the stretch (`normalForm_iff`); the form is idempotent (`normalForm_normal`) and lexicographically least (`normalForm_least`). `Triple` retains a three-exchange witness: the first and last are joined, and reversing their order changes the normal form and prevents reachability.

The exact boundary is `complete_iff`: a `CompleteInvariant`, specifically a natural-number-valued invariant compared over that finite stretch, exists exactly where such a decision of apartness exists. This is not a claim about invariants in arbitrary codomains with undecidable equality. Comparing the two arrangements that place a selected pair side by side gives the reverse direction (`pair_rearranges`, `decides_of_complete`). It decides apartness, not joining itself; the latter is determined only up to double negation.

With a containing footprint and that decision, `Footprinted.normalize` reaches a world by unjoined commutations, preserves balance, dissipation, acting, taking, dependence, embodiment and transmission in both directions (`normalize_premises`), and preserves the order under renumbering (`normalize_precedes`). Reorderings with the same arrangement have the same exchanges and show every relatum alike on the stretch (`reorder_determined`). Normalize any independent reordering while naming its exchanges by their steps in the original world, and its exchanges and relational reading agree with the original normal form (`normalize_reorder`). The fixed naming is part of this statement.

A census carries forward through **every** commutation, even with unsplit sides: `listed_splice` constructs the intermediate list from one side before and the other after the commuted pair (`Web.commute_census`, `Web.commute_standingCensus`). The converse needs split sides (`World.commute_counted_iff` and the two back lemmas). Thus any `Reorders`, joined pairs included, preserves existence of an activity census and a standing census in both directions (`Reorders.census`), since splitting is part of that relation. Arbitrary `Footprinted.reorder` preserves a census forward; independent reorderings of a containing footprint preserve it both ways (`reorder_census`). This asserts census existence, not equal population at each intermediate step, and does not undo P78's `Crossing` and `Arising` counterexamples to preservation of other premises. Together with the existing `World.withoutIdle_counted`, it connects both kinds of rereading to counting.

For the least footprint, `DecidesIdle L W idle` decides, at **every** step and relatum, taking no part in the exchange and being unmoved across it. `Footprinted.least` touches exactly what is not idle, contains the exchanges and is contained in every containing footprint (`least_touch_iff`, `least_contains`, `least_le`). Its joining and order relations are therefore contained in theirs (`least_joined`, `least_precedes`), and every renumbering they keep is kept by it (`least_keeps`, connected to reachability by P78's `sorts_iff`). The construction needs the supplied idleness decision; its converse characterization additionally needs decidable equality of relata. With `[DecidableEq X]`, a least Boolean containing footprint exists exactly where idleness is decided (`least_exists_iff`), equivalently where being unmoved is decided for nonparticipants (`decidesIdle_iff`). Membership in the supplied finite exchange list is then decided. This boundary is an equivalence, not a concrete world witnessing undecidability.

The producer/consumer connection is explicit: P78 supplies `Footprinted`, its containment, joining and order, finite reindexings, `Reorders`, sorting and premise preservation; P88 consumes those interfaces to construct the representative, census and least footprint. The original task, module and historical logs remain hash-preserved in `development/becoming-p88-landing/`. The old logs are not source-bound consolidated verification. Actual integrated evidence, filled only after successful checks: receipt `20261013T091820.375259Z`, 101 `OrderNormal` theorems, and periphery receipt `20261013T091907.838571Z`. The takeover review checks stated scope and dependencies; it is not an independent full proof review.

Not shown: an unnamed normal form, Foata's simultaneous layers, a normal form of an unbounded run, a least footprint without the idleness decision, a concrete undecidable-idleness world, or actual correspondence with continuous time. The sides of `Reorders` remain given. Empty axiom reports do not derive the representation or establish a complete explanation of every real process. The readings are the AI's, pending Ren; no ethical predicate, ranking or axiom occurs.

**Entropy: what becoming leaves, and what holding it costs (R5).** After section 59.4 Ren read the least loss per exchange as entropy (‘I know what "Every exchange loses at least one smallest amount" is now, it is entropy’), asked whether 0 is possible and whether entropy can be derived (‘so that makes me to speculate if 0 is possible, if we can also derive entropy from this, if we can, spawn a new session to focus on this’), and confirmed that the case of 0 means zero premises (‘pure thermodynamics, at atomic level, each exchange between objects holds the conservation of energy, but entropy still rise. zero premises. but for if "lossless exist", can we find a path, to figure out, and prove along the way?’) ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-11-difference-in-becoming.md)). The new module `Becoming.Entropy` answers, strongest form first.

- **With no premise, the history grows.** In a balanced flow every change of a level is an exchange (`Flow.Balances.exchanges_of_change`). The history of a family's exchanges (`Flow.history`) never shrinks (`Flow.history_mono`), and an exchange with its reverse (`Flow.Reverses`) restores every level while the history counts both (`Flow.Balances.restores_levels_not_history`): Ren's ‘its reverse transformation will take another change’. This is the spine's form of the distinction already drawn by `endpoint-loss-and-return` and the counter of `ReturnConditions.lean`.
- **Zero loss is possible, exactly where lossless.** Under the first law at a fixed unit (`Flow.Gainless`, nothing from nothing), the reverse of an exchange is within the law exactly where the exchange loses nothing (`Flow.Reverses.gainlessOn_iff`); under dissipation none is reversed (`Flow.Dissipative.irreversible`). In `Passing` a carrier hands a unit back and forth in a finite, balanced, lossless, enclosed world, each exchange reversed at the next step, its history growing by one at every step without end (`Passing.passes`, `Passing.history_grows`).
- **The least loss is a record held in the conserved amount.** With the record counted as one more condition, given to and never taken from (`Flow.withRecord`), a flow dissipates on a family exactly where every exchange conserves the family with its record exactly and leaves the record at least one unit (`Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_conserved`), and exactly where, recording each exchange at one unit, the family with its record gains nothing (`Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_unitRecord`); both parts are needed (`Passing.record_needs_both`), and under the first law the record receives exactly what is dissipated (`Flow.GainlessOn.residues_lost`). This is the shape of Ren's analogy, each exchange conserving while the record rises, but it decomposes the least loss rather than deriving it.
- **The second-law form.** The amount dissipated (`Flow.dissipated`) never falls, with the stock it is conserved under the first law (`Flow.Balances.stock_dissipated`), the history is within it (`Flow.Balances.history_within`), and under loss in proportion `q` everything taken is at most `q + 1` times it (`Flow.uptake_within_dissipated`).
- **Recurrence and the count of configurations.** Under the first law the configuration stays among the configurations of its stock, listed exactly (`configurations_exact`, the Einstein-solid count); a family never revisiting one changes at most that many times and rests (`Flow.Balances.changes_within_lossless`, `Flow.Balances.rests_of_never_revisits`), so change without end revisits (`Flow.Balances.unending_change_revisits`). `Settling` rests without the least loss.
- **No arrow of the levels.** A quantity of the configuration that never falls and rises at every change (`Web.Arrow`) rules out revisiting, so under the first law no such quantity exists while change goes on (`Flow.Balances.no_arrow`, `World.no_arrow`); `Passing` has none while its history grows.
- **Merging.** Where change is a function of the configuration (`Web.Determined`), rest after a change merges two configurations, with no law of the flow (`Web.merges_of_settles`); merging none, change once begun never stops, so under the first law the family revisits (`Flow.Balances.revisits_of_apart`); never revisiting, under an arrow or dissipation, it merges (`Flow.Balances.merges_of_arrow`, `Flow.Balances.merges_of_dissipates`). `Passing` swaps and merges nothing; `Settling` merges, with an arrow rising once (`Settling.merges`).
- **Holding the history.** A configuration carrying the history makes its reading an arrow (`Flow.Balances.arrow_of_carries`), so exchange stops within the configurations (`Flow.Balances.exchange_stops_of_carries`), and a finite world under the first law that keeps exchanging forgets (`World.forgets`).
- **The laws of change, read on the family.** After R6 landed (`Becoming.Recurrence`, record recurrence-without-premise), its laws are read on the family, as agreed with its owner: revisiting after a change is revisiting (`Web.Revisits.recurs`), an arrow marks every change (`Web.Arrow.marks`), a merge along the family is a merge of the law (`Web.Merges.law`), determined change runs along the law's orbit (`Web.Determined.orbit`). The first law keeps the configurations within the stock at `T` (`Flow.Balances.held`), and that bound is the supplied premise: from every step on the configuration takes one value twice, constructively (`Flow.Balances.recurs`); an arrow stops change (`Flow.Balances.arrow_stops`); within the bound a law merging nothing brings the start back (`Flow.Balances.returns_of_lossless`; the bound does the work, since `Law.succ_open` merges nothing and never returns); the present forgets the kept history (`Flow.Balances.present_forgets`); an arrow or dissipation rules out a law merging nothing (`Flow.Balances.not_lossless_of_arrow`, `Flow.Balances.not_lossless_of_dissipates`).
- **An arrow drawn from beyond.** In `Gathering` a record takes a unit from a new relatum at every step: every exchange conserves exactly, every step is enclosed, and the record's level rises without end, in a world that is not finite (`Gathering.gathers`).

On the AI's reading, pending Ren: becoming leaves a difference with no premise, as history; what costs is holding it. In a finite enclosure, a configuration that holds the history runs out of configurations, a rising quantity of the levels needs a merging of distinctions, and the record held in the conserved amount is exactly the least loss per exchange. So Ren's entropy has two readings, exactly related: as history it needs no premise; as the record in the conserved amount it is the spine's dissipation. Correspondences to Clausius, Boltzmann, Zermelo, Loschmidt, Landauer, Bennett and Gouy–Stodola are readings, not physical derivations; a coarse-grained entropy rising from an ordered start needs a premise about the start and is not stated. Record entropy-history-and-record added. Receipt 20261013T093441.881086Z (Entropy 185 theorems, 233 declaration audits), periphery receipt 20261013T093542.175797Z. Not yet independently reviewed; the author's counterreview is in section 80.

**General laws for the older records: viability, countdown, lasting and never reaching (14 October 2026).** Section 114 takes up three groups left for later in section 113: market-protected-continuation, the six correction and shutdown protocol records, and the three market records. - **Viability** (`Becoming.Viability`, 25 theorems). No course from a configuration leaves a guard exactly when some certificate (a set within the guard that every step keeps) contains it (`kernel_iff_certificate`); the viability kernel is the largest. For a law driven by admissible disturbances, given one, no history ever leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance (`never_leaves_iff_certificate`); with none the law fails (`needs_admissible`). The market is an instance for every parameter set, bound set and start (`MarketInstances.never_fails_iff`), and `safe_history_never_fails` follows from the safe rectangle.
- **Countdown** (`Becoming.Countdown`, 20 theorems). An admitted course keeps a property exactly when every admitted step does (`admitted_invariant_iff`). Counted work finishes in `work + 1` ticks exactly when the fuel covers them; every shorter run leaves it pending, so where pending and finished exclude each other no shorter run finishes (`completes_iff`, `pending_before`, `not_done_before`). Every admitted course longer than a reserved margin ends at the exit, and the bound is attained (`exits`, `Slow.misses`). The mediated and recoverable histories, supported publication (`ProtocolInstances.publishes_iff`), the reserved stop and the versioned head (`VersionedTaskInstances.head_completes`, with Mathlib) are instances.
- **Lasting** (`Becoming.Lasting`, 36 theorems). A start lasts `n` steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level `n`, and exactly when every necessary family does (`lasts_iff_ladder`, `lasts_iff_necessary`); what no course leaves is what lasts every horizon (`kernel_iff_lasts`). Below level `n` of a drained family every admissible history leaves the guard within `n` steps (`Drains.leaves`), and being at level `n` does not suffice (`Collapse.level_not_lasting`); with growth bounded by a monotone map this gives `exhausts`. A determined law never reaches a target exactly when a closed set avoiding the target contains the start (`avoids_iff_closed`).
- **Market instances.** `finite_support_forces_failure` is an instance of `exhausts`. The cover recurrence is a ladder for every correction schedule, so the supported prefixes are instances, and at the worst share the cover is exact (`cover_exact`). For 0 ≤ b ≤ 3/4 every positive seed lands exactly when the quality margin at 3/8 is nonnegative (`lands_iff_margin`), and exactly when no closed set avoiding landing contains a positive seed (`lands_iff_no_closed`); above 5/12 the fixed configuration is one.

**General laws for the older records: copying and retrodiction (14 October 2026).** Under the same approval, section 115 proves the two groups section 113 left for later.
- **Copying** (`Becoming.Copying`, 65 theorems). For every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws, a copy's product is the word exactly when the pool holds each token at least as often as the word uses it and the support covers what its attachments draw (`built_iff`, `completes_iff`), and with a release exactly when the support also covers it (`releases_iff`). Copies from one shared pool are all released exactly when the pool supplies the words together and the support covers all draws and releases (`batch_all_iff`), whatever their order (`batch_all_swap`). Under local draws, a word's use of support depends on the law only through unlike adjacent pairs (`use_word`, `use_midpoint`, `use_lt_iff`). A copy reading through a registration reproduces a word exactly when every site reads its token and the copy is supplied and covered (`reading_iff`). Inspection never increases the defects for any product exactly where the reference is faithful (`inspect_le_iff`), scans of such sites never do (`scan_le`), and a defective site takes the reference's token exactly when the pool holds it and the support covers both draws (`inspect_matches_iff`). Doubling runs n rounds from k units exactly when the stock covers d·k(2ⁿ−1) (`doubling_iff`).
- **Copy machines** (periphery `CopyingInstances`, 63 theorems). Each machine move is a core move. The structural machine reproduces a strand exactly when the pool supplies its tokens and the support covers its draws plus one, for every pool, with the old theorem of the support needed as the instance. Chain growth follows the same law. n rounds reach k·2ⁿ mature chains exactly when the support covers 9·k(2ⁿ−1), which is the core doubling with draw 9. Reading through contacts holds for every registration state, and only copy moves change the product. Inspection never increases defects exactly where the reference is faithful, and the old wrong reference is unfaithful at the inspected site.
- **Retrodiction** (`Becoming.Retrodiction`, 17 theorems). The law holds for every type of histories, dates, relations, probes and reports. The actual history fits its records. Every explanation of an earlier packet by a family history fitting the records gives the actual content exactly when every family rival giving the same packet with another content is separated by some dated control (`reading_right_iff`, `look_right_iff`). Where the relation takes two values, controls at both ends of a span that read the same settle every date between exactly when at most one change is admitted or no date lies between (`bracket_settles_iff`), with the excursion as the counterexample. A change seen at both ends is not located (`change_unlocated`).
- **Source histories** (periphery `RetrodictionInstances`, 21 theorems). The four-moment histories are instances: bracketing controls settle naming in the one-change envelope (`controls_settle_naming`), and later deterioration and improvement are instances. The late-control, split-control and omitted-excursion cases are the law's failing side; the excursion is read wrongly outside the one-change family.
- **Still one-directional**: `finite_lineage_inherits` (sufficiency only) and the chain's bonds in `registered_copy_cells`. The change envelope remains a supplied premise.

New names are structural (the law of draws `draw` and `pairDraw`, `use`, `used`, `drawSupport`), not market words; the old machines keep their names, which older records cite. **General laws for the older records: reaching, lineages and the chain's bonds (14 October 2026).** Section 116 takes up items 11 and 14 of the open-issues plan (Ren: “please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session): the landing side left in section 114 and the two one-directional results left in section 115. Where a direction needs a decision, the decision is an explicit hypothesis and a theorem shows that it is needed.
- **Reaching** (`Becoming.Lasting`, now 69 theorems). A start reaches a target within n steps on every admissible disturbance exactly when some funnel holds it at level n (level 0 in the target; a configuration at level k + 1 is in the target or every admissible step takes it to level k), and exactly when every basin does (`reaches_iff_funnel`, `reaches_iff_basin`); `Reaches` is the largest funnel and the least basin, the dual of the ladder law. Reaching composes (`Reaches.trans`). The idea of funnels with Prop-valued levels, and of reaching as the least necessary family, is from the session Current math core. For a determined law, reaching is meeting the target on the orbit, with no premise (`reaches_iff_orbit`), so the orbit meets the target within n steps exactly when some funnel holds the start (`orbit_reaches_iff_funnel`), the dual of `avoids_iff_closed`; with a decided target, exactly when some numeric variant at most n at the start is lowered by every step outside the target (`orbit_reaches_iff_variant`), and exactly when the start does not last n steps outside the target (`reaches_iff_not_lasts`). Each decision is needed: a numeric variant for every determined law would decide equality (`numeric_needs_decision`), the duality for every target would eliminate double negation (`dual_needs_decision`), and the histories converse for every target would give the limited principle of omniscience (`Search.histories_need_decision`).
- **The landing side** (periphery `MarketInstances`, 45 theorems). For every determined rational law, a quantity that each step from a kept region outside the target raises by a fixed gain, up to a bound, gives a funnel (`rising_funnel`). For 0 ≤ b ≤ 5/12 the market's three gain estimates (share, then influence, then quality) supply such funnels from a settled region the law keeps, composed by `Reaches.trans`; a positive seed enters its region by the old seed retention and positive-gap estimates. So every positive seed reaches landing (`seed_reaches_landing`), `partial_finite_landing` and, at b = 0, `positive_seed_finite_landing` are instances (`landing_side_instance`, `rescue_landing_instance`), and the 5/12 boundary follows from the core's laws (`landing_boundary_instance`). The gain estimates are the instance's content; the horizon depends on the seed's share. `every_finite_stock_has_obstructed_positive_seeds` is an instance of exhaustion (`obstructed_seeds_instance`).
- **Lineages** (`Becoming.Copying`, now 68 theorems; periphery `CopyingInstances`, 86 theorems). Copying one word n times in turn from one pool, every copy is released exactly when the pool holds each token n times as often as the word uses it and the support covers n times its draws and release (`lineage_all_iff`). On the machine, the support used is n times the draws and release exactly when every reproduction is released (`lineage_used_iff`): the converse of `finite_lineage_inherits`, whose premises are the sufficient side (`finite_lineage_instance`). Read on the strands alone the converse is false (`strands_do_not_show_release`).
- **The chain's bonds.** Every course of the registration machine keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens (`path_shaped_along`, an instance of `Countdown.invariant_iff_reach`), so complete registration copies the template, bonds included, exactly when its bonds are that path (`registered_copy_iff`); the bonds need nothing beyond the tokens, and the old `registered_inheritance` is the instance without its non-empty premise. Chain growth and the mature chain hold bonds included (`grow_strand_iff`, `mature_strand_iff`).

**General laws for the older records: cross-situational reading and every history of the machines (14 October 2026).** Under Ren's approval of the open-issues plan (“please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session), section 117 states the laws for three one-history binding records, whose link from the history to its interpretation inputs was a `decide` on one history, and for four machine records that were only partly general.
- **Cross-situational resolution** (`Becoming.CrossSituational`, 37 theorems). For every type of records and meanings and every reading of bearing and offering, a form resolves to a meaning of a repertoire without repeats exactly when every bearing record offers it and every other meaning is missing from some bearing record (`candidates_eq_iff`, `resolves_iff`); without distinct meanings the law fails (`Repeated`). Later records only narrow (`candidates_append`, `narrows`, `stays_iff`). Where every bearing record offers the target, any unique candidate is the target (`resolved_is_target`), and one record omitting it can leave a wrong one (`Omitted`). Records read through a family of explanations resolve to the target exactly when every rival is ruled out by a bearing record no family world with the rival explains (`resolves_explained_iff`); where words are recovered, every sequence is read right exactly when each word's records separate its meaning (`reads_every_iff`).
- **Machines** (periphery `MachineInstances`, 96 theorems, was 44). An acquired word resolves to its atom exactly when its admitted records separate it (`resolve_iff`). After every history of moves and namings, from every situation whose record groups the encoding, every sequence is read exactly when the earlier records and those heard, each offering what was accessible where the learner stood, separate every atom (`scene_interprets_every_iff`); `coordinated 37` is an instance, and the stationary and mistimed histories fail separation and coverage. Cooperative naming narrows exactly the words whose atoms are accessible (`naming_narrows`), and `acquired 51` is an instance of the separation law. Retained packets reread through learned routes resolve to the target exactly when every rival is ruled out by a packet no learned world with the rival produces (`retrospective_resolves_iff`); the coverage theorem follows, `retrospective 36` is an instance, and after a real route change the target is not produced. Learning is better than attendance exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, and revision completes exactly there (`better_iff`, `completed_iff_better`). From every state a practice round completes exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose method answers as the context does, and then only records the review, trains the worker and completes the trial (`round_iff`); the three rounds of the complete history are instances.
- **Versioned tasks** (periphery `VersionedTaskInstances`, 22 theorems, was 11). For every condition and every valid installation with a pending head, acquired revision reaches the pending task exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance and ends in the learning practice with the one earlier loss (`continuation_eq`); the harmful headline is the instance. For every condition, report and pending endpoint, a review adds a loss exactly when the report clears the relevant risk, the work covers the review-and-action course and the risk, its outcome law's loss condition, holds (`review_losses`, `review_adds_loss_iff`); uncleared reviews keep the loss count (`losses_kept`, an instance of `Gated.KeptBy`).

What stays each construction's own content is said as such: the scene's accessibility, the source model, the rule choosing the next visit, the two outcome laws (and so which risk is relevant), the goal encoding, the work units and the practice machine's steps. `cycles_iff` is not stated as a `Stock` instance (two coupled stocks with state-dependent replenishment), and no reading made the revisions instances of `Becoming.Revision` or `ContinuingRevision`. New names are structural; the old machines keep theirs. **Likeness completed: carrying a law through an equivalence, and branching tests (14 October 2026).** Under Ren's "move towards 100%", the likeness row of Current math core on the work board (approved by the integrator, outside the open-issues plan), section 118 answers the next steps of determinacy-up-to-likeness, tests-fix-likeness-where-determined and configurations-alike-by-relation, in `Becoming.Likeness` (61 theorems).
- **Carrying a law up to likeness.** Some process on the descriptions, determined up to likeness under the claims, admits every step read through `π` exactly when some equivalence on the descriptions relates only descriptions realizing the same claims and takes configurations whose descriptions it relates, by one move, to configurations whose descriptions it relates (`carries_law_alike_iff`). The carrier is the image closed under the equivalence. Where each description is its own claim the only such equivalence is equality, which is `carries_law_iff` (`carries_law_named_iff`).
- **The image.** It is determined up to likeness exactly where configurations whose descriptions are alike in it go alike under it (`image_determinedAt_iff`), but it is no longer the least carrier: in `Parting` the identity carries a law up to likeness while its image is not determined up to likeness at the start.
- **Never returning, projections and difference-making.** A run that never returns up to likeness fixes up to likeness no move other than the one it takes (`Run.not_fixesAlike_other_of_new`). Read through a projection, a move not taken at a description alike to the one named is not fixed up to likeness, under any process on the descriptions determined up to likeness that admits the steps so read (`Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_untaken`), and so wherever some equivalence registering the claims makes configurations go alike (`Run.not_fixesThroughAlike_of_goAlikeUnder`): Mechanism's `not_fixesThrough_of_untaken` and `not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike` up to likeness. The dichotomy of difference-making needs only that every step by the move from the withheld configuration reaches one level of the condition (`Dependence.dichotomy_of_same_level`); determinacy up to likeness under claims registering the level, and determinacy, are cases.
- **Branching tests fix likeness, constructively.** Alike configurations pass the same branching tests, with no premise. Where the moves and claims are listed and both frames are finite with decided steps and claims (`FiniteDecided`), configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same branching tests (`alike_iff_sameBranchingTests`). Likeness to depth k is decided, a separating test is built where it fails, and likeness to depth stops refining at a depth no greater than the number of pairs of configurations (`AlikeTo.steady_within`), where it is a bisimulation. So likeness of finite decided frames is decided (`Alike.decided`). Deciding it for every pair of one-configuration frames is excluded middle (`alike_decided_iff_em`). This answers the question `Becoming.Histories` left open; the periphery's `same_iff_bisimilar` reasons classically.
- **When a choice is made.** The test that the first move can lead to a configuration where both `b` and `c` can be taken holds for `Choosing.late` and fails for `Choosing.early` (`Choosing.branching_apart`).

Whether the equivalence needs the decisions is open, and the bridge from `BranchingTest` to the periphery's `Test` is not written. Two records were migrated to schema 2 with mapping tables. The two items this section leaves open (whether the equivalence needs the decisions, and the bridge to the periphery's `Test`) are answered in section 120.

**What a learner can learn through its registration (14 October 2026).** Section 119 takes up the item that section 92's counterreview (item 8) and learning-by-refutation left open: learning where registration does not tell values apart. The new core module `Becoming.Learnable` (17 theorems, 23 declarations; it imports Identification and Seeking and changes no existing module) states, for every determined law and every registration, with no premise:
- **Alike to the registration, learned alike.** Two configurations with the same registered future give every learner the same record at every step (`records_same`). So at a step where their targets differ a claim is right on at most one, with no decision (`claim_not_right_on_both`), and with the target's values decided it is refuted on one while the records stay equal everywhere (`refuted_on_one`). A learner resting on both has targets agreeing from some step on (`agree_of_rests_both`); where they differ at arbitrarily late steps none rests on both (`not_rests_on_both`), already for two configurations the law leaves unchanged (`still_not_rests_on_both`).
- **Read off the registration.** A target read off what registers (`val s = g (reg s)`) is learned by the learner over the lasso hypotheses on the registered values, given neither the configurations, nor how many there are, nor any value of the target, from the identification bound on (`rests_through`, P83's `held_learner_rests` read through `g`).
- **Exactly.** In a world a list holds, some learner reading the registration rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same registered future have targets agreeing from some step on (`learnable_iff`). The necessary side holds of every learner, whatever it is given; the learner of the sufficient side is given the world and the target (`withWorld`). Targets going alike across the registration are learnable (`learnable_of_lumped`); under a law leaving every configuration unchanged exactly those are (`still_learnable_iff_lumped`). Under other laws more is learnable, for example a target reading the next registered value.
- **Witness.** Registering the first of two coordinates, no learner rests on the second at both `(true, false)` and `(true, true)`; registering both, the lasso learner rests from step 2 (`Pair`).

The author's counterreview concedes three points. The necessary side follows directly from `records_same`. `rests_through` restates `held_learner_rests`. The sufficient side's learner is given the world, so a learner given nothing is shown only for targets read off the present registration. The learner still tells registered values apart. On the AI's reading, pending Ren, registration bounds what is learned: this is P49's blindness below threshold, stated for learners, and what lies beyond it is reached only by widening the registration. Scratch build on main `a04727a4`, every axiom report empty; the landing run binds the receipt. Not yet independently reviewed. **The decisions cannot be dropped; the core's branching tests are the periphery's (14 October 2026).** Under Ren's "move towards 100%", the likeness row of Current math core and the bridge item after it (approved by the integrator), section 120 answers the remaining items of tests-fix-likeness-where-determined, in `Becoming.Likeness` (109 theorems) and the Likeness section of `Becoming.Bridge`.
- **With only each move's outcomes listed, exactly one principle is needed.** Where configurations may be infinitely many but each move's outcomes are listed and the claims decided (`OutcomesListed`), the same branching tests make configurations alike given `EitherThroughout`: of two decided families α, β, each holding at a step where it holds at the next, with α k or β k at every k, one holds at every k (`OutcomesListed.alike_iff_sameBranchingTests`). Conversely, the theorem for every such frame gives the principle (`alike_of_sameBranchingTests_outcomes_iff`, through `Chains`: a start stepping to two chains that go on while α, respectively β, holds, and one stepping also to a chain that always goes on, pass the same tests and are alike only where one family holds throughout). Excluded middle gives the principle (`EitherThroughout.of_em`). The principle is `EitherNever`, of two decided families not both holding somewhere one holding nowhere (`eitherThroughout_iff_eitherNever`), and `NowhereDecided`, that whether a decided family holds nowhere is decided, gives it (`EitherThroughout.of_nowhereDecided`). Where a move has infinitely many outcomes branching tests need not fix likeness, with no principle needed to show it (`Unbounded.sameBranchingTests`, `Unbounded.not_alike`). Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): by its standard name the principle is LLPO, the lesser limited principle of omniscience, here for decreasing families; `EitherNever` is its de Morgan form, and `NowhereDecided` is WLPO, the weak limited principle of omniscience.
- **Neither decision can be dropped from the equivalence.** For every frame on listed configurations with one move and no claims, that passing the same branching tests makes configurations alike holds exactly under excluded middle (`alike_of_sameBranchingTests_iff_em`): in `EitherStep`, a configuration with three successors and one with two pass the same tests whatever a proposition is, since the third successor, which can go on exactly where the proposition holds, passes what one of the other two passes, and they are alike only where the proposition is decided. With decided steps and one claim the same holds (`alike_of_sameBranchingTests_decided_steps_iff_em`, through `EitherClaim`).
- **One kind of test.** The core's `BranchingTest` and the periphery's `ExplanatoryBranching.Test` have the same five constructors. They translate one to one (`BranchingTest.toTest`, `BranchingTest.ofTest`, both round trips), and a branching test holds in a model's frame exactly where its translation holds in the model (`BranchingTest.holds_toTest`). So passing the same tests is the same in both (`sameBranchingTests_iff_same`).
- **Constructive on finite decided models.** Where the moves and conditions are listed and both models' frames are finite and decided, passing the periphery's same tests is likeness (`same_iff_alike_of_finiteDecided`): `same_iff_bisimilar` on such models with no classical reasoning.
- **The classical side stays in the periphery.** For image-finite models the direction from the tests to likeness remains the periphery's `same_iff_bisimilar`, whose proof is classical; the checker requires empty axiom reports in the bridge, so it is not restated there. Landed as the first queue item after batch 4: core receipt 20261014T100026.593496Z (empty core axiom reports, the core compiling from the prelude), `Becoming.Likeness` 109 theorems and `Becoming.Bridge` 53; three records bind them and seven further records that bind Bridge.lean follow its hash. The decidability inventory is unchanged on the receipt: `Decided` binders are not read as a decidability family, a blind spot taken up as a separate item by Current math core.

**What linear tests see: every branching postponed until it shows; four readings (14 October 2026).** Ren asked about the readings of the three likeness records and the names of two principles ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-14-likeness-readings.md)), and after the answer said “push as far as possible, as strong as possible, generally agree with your direction”. Section 121 adds the core module `Becoming.Postponement` (16 theorems, no premise).
- **Postponement.** In `Frame.postponed F` a configuration is a family of configurations, those a course may have reached; a move goes from a family to the family of its members' outcomes by that move, and a family realizes a claim where some member does. The postponed frame does not branch: it is determined up to likeness everywhere (`Frame.postponed_determinedAt`).
- **Linear tests are likeness with every branching postponed** (`sameTests_iff_postponed_alike`), and **a frame is alike to its postponement exactly where it is determined up to likeness** (`alike_postponed_iff_determined`). The two `Choosing` frames are alike once postponed; the early one is not alike to its postponement. So linear tests miss exactly where the unfolding branches. This is the subset construction of automata theory (trace equivalence as bisimilarity after determinization), stated constructively in the core and joined to the likeness records.
- **Readings (the AI's; Ren agreed with the direction).** “Where the unfolding branches” in place of “when a choice is made”; equality as the finest registration, naming, so that the laws needing equality need something registered; the identity of configurations as likeness, relative to what is realized, carried as a relation, and fixed by the whole continuation, so that it can outrun finite tests; LLPO and WLPO as the standard names of the two principles, neither a premise, the Lean names structural.

**Peripheral proofs joined to the spine, integration I1 (14 October 2026).** Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”. Section 122 measures the gap and joins the records whose proof modules the spine run already compiles.
- **Measure.** `SPINE-INTEGRATION.py` reads the consolidated receipt, classifies each record by where its Lean proof is checked, and counts the theorems outside the run once per file stem and name, older versions of run modules left out. On receipt 20261014T100026.593496Z (138 modules: 95 core, 3 foundation, 4 bridge, 36 inherited), of 203 records on main 146 were stated on the spine by canonical source or alias, 6 had their main proof in an inherited module, 41 outside the run and 10 none; after this section 149, 3, 41 and 10, and the records citing some spine proof go from 148 to 154. Outside the run, live paths hold about 11,000 distinct theorems in about 540 modules, and about 8,000 more appear only in copies and evidence; the largest families are universal-ethics, inquiry-root, deeper, the general-framework top level and connected.
- **Branching tests fix likeness on image-finite models under excluded middle.** With excluded middle as a hypothesis, configurations passing the same branching tests are alike wherever each move's outcomes are listed, the moves and claims unlisted (`alike_of_sameBranchingTests_of_em`), so the periphery's `same_iff_bisimilar` is a theorem of the core with that hypothesis (`same_iff_bisimilar_of_em`). The cases now run: finite and decided, no principle (§118); moves and claims listed, exactly `EitherThroughout` (§120); nothing listed but each move's outcomes, excluded middle suffices. Whether something weaker suffices there is open.
- **Target uniqueness.** Where likeness, or branching tests, tell a frame's configurations apart, a configuration is alike to, or passes the same tests as, at most one of them (`Alike.functional`, `SameBranchingTests.functional`); `same_functional` is the latter through `separated_iff`.
- **Self-good's second step is N_rel on profiles.** On the valuation whose claims are a standpoint's profiles, tolerance is N_rel's neutrality, a chain of small steps is reach along related profiles and S0 under supervenience is S0, so `tolerant_chain_reaches` follows from the core's `Valuation.reaches` (`tolerant_chain_reaches_by_core`). Every profile counts as living, so the relation runs through merely possible profiles; whether small steps between profiles are formed relations stays a correspondence question.

Next: I3, instance or equivalence theorems for the modules the 41 records outside the run rely on, starting with deeper's Explanatory family; I4, a classification of the about 540 live modules (join, keep as application, or mark as an earlier version with the spine result replacing it), which awaits Ren, with nothing deleted.
