"Strictly matched below no configuration" said the reverse; `fragile_b3_below_nothing` is renamed `fragile_b3_better_than_none`.
- **Scope (G3–G5).** Substitution preserves consumption "exactly" under every such transformation (`Web.consumingIn_kept_iff`); the bracket law needs the relation to take two values and the end controls to read the same (`bracket_settles_iff`); `pending_before` gives "every shorter run leaves it pending", and "no shorter run finishes" needs pending and finished to exclude each other (`not_done_before`).
- **Presentation (G6, G7).** Reading at episode time keeps a missed claim missed by the definition of `ReadsAt`, so whether an actual frame reads at episode time is the premise (`not_readsAt_of_recovery`). The support-gated family's balance as a flow holds by construction, since the focal take is defined as what the step removes; the instance's content is the given amounts and the family's arithmetic.
- **Names (G8–G11).** Market words become structural ones: `Flow.surplus_raises_at`, `Flow.surplus_bounded_at` → `net_give_raises_at`, `net_give_bounded_at`; `SupportGated.surplus`, `surplus_active`, `surplus_step` → `netGive`, `netGive_active`, `netGive_step`; `ProtocolInstances.charge_some`, `charge_none` → `unit_drawn`, `stalls_unsupported`; "joint surplus" → "joint net giving", "funded completion" → "supported completion", "cost one level" → "lower the level by one", "costs the stock a unit" → "takes one unit of the stock". Old machines keep their names. Statements and proofs are unchanged.

**Periphery proofs joined to the spine, integration I3a (14 October 2026).** Continuing column I (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”), section 124 states twenty of the 41 records whose main proof lay outside the spine run on the spine; the measure goes from 149 to 169 stated on the spine and from 41 to 21 outside (citing a spine proof, 154 → 173). Two agents (Opus 5.5) drafted one core module and its bridge each.
- **Five general laws, no premise.** A comparison satisfying C that is read off a description through an irreflexive relation needs the description to separate every extension from its base (`Comparison.separates`), and a natural-number score satisfying C rises without bound along an endless chain of extensions (`Comparison.outgrows`): the marginal and the counted-gain counterexamples are instances. Every weighting of a listed domain keeps an event's mass from falling exactly where the event is included (`every_weighting_iff`), and the chance floor is `mass_mono` twice. Fallible witnesses tell two answers apart exactly where their fault sets leave a common faithful witness (`no_common_report_iff`), and a reduction carries the futures exactly where it merges only configurations with the same futures (`futures_through_iff`): fallible inspection and the derived history law are instances. What can be had from a configuration is kept exactly where it can be had again (`keeps_reach_iff_returns`, `not_returns_iff_loses`), and a law is fixed by its traces (`same_steps_iff_traces`).
- **Parts (Becoming.Composition).** A joint frame adds one relation, a configuration holding two configurations together as its parts; whole and parts are configurations of one unfolding. Where moves and pairs of parts are compact and tests stable, configurations are jointly alike exactly where they pass the same joint tests; without stability the law, asked of every such frame, is exactly excluded middle (`jointAlike_of_sameJointTests_iff_em`, `matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em`). A description lifts the parts exactly where what it identifies matches parts (`liftsFromEach_iff`), and realized nested plans with exclusive footprints draw on the root without repeating.
- **Joinings (Becoming.Joining).** Read through partners, a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (`Joining.lifts_iff`); read through roles, joinings with alike roots have a common refinement and open maps factor uniquely at every fragment, with no finiteness or decision, while reading through roles can lose whether a fragment joins itself, which retained references keep.
- **Three senses of joined.** Ten records are instances with no added hypothesis (for two of them the trivial positivity conjunct is not restated). Six add one named hypothesis, stability of tests or excluded middle, which is what the periphery's classical proof used. Four are restated on the core's role or retained frames, because the periphery's incidence and register definitions compile through `propext`. The landing run compiles 26 more periphery modules as inherited (each has a passed receipt for its current bytes) and rebinds the new aliases. Next, I3b: the remaining 21, starting with the shared stock and the observation family; I4 awaits Ren.

**The relation-first re-founding: laws on the levels alone, premises read off the exchange, readings in context (14 October 2026).** Ren asked “why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?” and wrote “no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”; after the answer proposed a re-founding in three steps, Ren wrote “please, finish all” ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-14-relation-first-refounding.md)), read as approving all three, including counting the rest of the whole as a relatum. The answer withdrew the earlier use of `World.independent` as evidence that the laws are not necessary: the independence measures the freedom of `World`'s eight separately chosen fields, not contingency in becoming. Section 125 adds three core modules (66 theorems, no premise; core receipt 20261015T143041.527461Z, CorrectionInquiry periphery receipt 20261015T143127.131125Z).
- **Laws on the levels alone (`Becoming.Novelty`).** With no flow, balance, loss or finiteness of the world, each law needing one state of the part written into it: a family whose stock stays within a bound returns (`Web.revisits_of_bounded`, `Web.returns_of_bounded`); a family new at each of the steps `T, …, T + N`, `N` the number of configurations within the bound, exceeds the bound at one of them, found by checking those finitely many steps (`Web.exceeds_of_new`), so what is new without end gains without bound (`Web.unbounded_of_new`, realized by `Web.counting`); no reading of a bounded configuration gives a record that never repeats or a count without bound, so a bounded family exchanged with at arbitrarily late steps does not carry the count of its exchanges, nor does a finite whole (`Web.unread_of_unbounded`, `Flow.uncarried_of_bounded`, `World.forgets_of_bounded`); with loss at each change, the changes over a stretch number at most the stock, and change does not recur without end (`Web.changes_le_stock`, `Web.rests_of_loses`). Entropy's returning, resting and forgetting under the first law are the cases with the bound balance supplies (`first_law_cases`).
- **Premises read off the exchange (`Becoming.Reading`).** Activity read as exchanging and drawing as taking, only active relata give and only active relata take, and only what they draw on, for every flow (`Flow.readOff_acting`, `Flow.readOff_taking`). With the rest of the whole counted as a relatum, every world balances, and its balance is exactly the rest never active (`World.withRest_balanced`, `World.withRest_closed_iff`). Under a law of exchange, with requirement read as what the exchange responds to, activity needs support for every need, so all four tying premises hold with no premise (`ExchangeLaw.readWeb_dependent`, `ExchangeLaw.readWorld_glue`); requirement is a counterfactual of the law that no course fixes (`ExchangeLaw.requirement_beyond_course`). What remains of the eight premises are states of parts: whether the rest is idle (closure, for a law feasibility), dissipation, embodiment, bounded transmission and the decision to list what is active.
- **One unfolding, read in context (`Becoming.Readings`).** The readings in context of a run are always one world whose relata are the indexed claims, with no gluing, quantum registrations included (`Contextual.world`); nothing stands or is exchanged in that world. The standing and the exchange read one change alike exactly where the flow balances, so a world's balance is the gluing of two readings (`Flow.changeReadings_glue_everywhere_iff`); with the rest counted the two glue at every step, and every world is one run of the law of exchange (`World.unity`). Under the same standard of invariance, significance from a standpoint holds within some boundary only by holding for everything (`presupposition_iff_all_of_invariant`, `bounded_invariant_iff`, restating checked results of `Becoming.Boundaries`; not new results).
- **Readings (the AI's, pending Ren).** A state of a part is like curvature, a state of a region, so a necessary law needs no necessary condition; novelty without end is gain without bound from beyond the part, and a bounded present cannot hold its own history; balance, only active relata giving and taking, and activity needing support tie readings of one exchange together, and the independence of the premises is the freedom of readings chosen apart from the exchange they read; `World` is the description free of context where the readings glue, and the axiom of Part II comes, under the invariance the laws meet, to the presupposition, Ren's “belief”.

**Exactness of the bounded record for every pair of bounds, P83b (15 October 2026).** P83's own next step, under Ren's “keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them” of 12 October. Section 97 proved that histories with at most N and N′ states are fixed by their record before N + N′ − 1, and that no shorter record does for N = 1 and N = N′. Section 126 shows it for every pair: given two values, for all M and M′ a history with at most M + 1 states and one with at most M′ + 1 share their record before M + M′ and differ at M + M′ (`Identification.bounded_agree_exact`). The first marks one step in every M + 1, with a mark at M + M′; the second follows it before M′ and then stays unmarked. One theorem is added to `Becoming.Identification`, with no new import, no existing statement changed and no axiom. For the two systems taken together this is Moore's bound, attained for every pair. The sharper bound within one history or one world, and for branching frames a depth bounded by the number of classes rather than of pairs, are not stated. Scratch build: 43 theorems, 55 declarations, empty axiom reports; the consolidated receipt follows the integrator's run. Not yet independently reviewed.

**Periphery proofs joined to the spine, integration I3b (14–15 October 2026).** Continuing column I, section 127 joins nine more records: seven are stated on the spine, and two are compiled in the run and connected to the core's scope. The measure goes from 169 to 176 stated on the spine, from 3 to 7 in inherited modules and from 21 to 10 outside (citing a spine proof, 173 → 180).
- **Laws in context and bounds on joint realization, no premise.** Pooling a family of laws runs exactly the courses some single context runs where those courses compose (`pooledLaw_exact_iff_joinClosed`); forgetting a changing context is exact where every context can follow each forgotten step (`erasedLaw_exact_iff_lifts`). A course carries every bound on realizing a bundle together, its own moves counted (`WithinMoves.after_course`), and a bundle no longer realizable together marks a course with no way back (`lost_together_not_returns`). The compatibility and joint-activation theorems are instances, and the core's proofs avoid the periphery's `propext` and `Quot.sound`.
- **Excluded middle, exactly.** Classification-robust comparison holds forward with no principle, and its converse for every type is exactly excluded middle (`classification_robust_iff_iff_em`); so is reading every recipe, or every guarded program, as one test (`Recipe.holds_after_iff_em`, `diamond_correct_iff_em`).
- **Granularity (Becoming.Granularity).** Every test of blocks is a finer test, with no premise; where the readings of two articulations agree, their histories match (excluded middle named). A recipe question is one of finitely many tests, so configurations passing the same tests answer it alike with no premise, which strengthens the periphery's classical `same_preserves_resumption`. What remains of a recipe resumes where the course stands. The witness `Midway` shows completed blocks and every nonempty prefix hiding a loss midway; it is restated on a core frame because the periphery's model compiles through `propext`.
- **Remaining.** Ten records stay outside. The shared stock has its core law (`every_event_within_iff`) and awaits a periphery instance; three need Mathlib (I3c); five are constructions, tools or documentation (I4, awaiting Ren); one awaits column E.

**Moore's bound and the depth by classes for branching frames, P83c (15 October 2026).** P83's next step, under Ren's “keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them” of 12 October and “offer it to them, keep proving” of 15 October (the branching part was offered to the owner of `Becoming.Likeness`, who agreed: add, don't replace). Section 128 adds the core module `Becoming.Refinement`: members a list holds that a relation keeps pairwise apart are no more than the list (`DistinctUnder.length_le`); a strict refinement adds a class (`Refining.grow`); so a chain of equivalences, each finer than the one before and decided among N members, with c of them apart at the first step, stops refining within N − c steps (`Refining.steady_within`). Three instances follow. Under a determined law on a list of N members closed under it, with the members' values compared decidedly, two members have the same registered future exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps (Moore's bound, `Law.sameFuture_iff_classes`; 2N − 1 before), exact for every N ≥ 2 (`Law.sameFuture_classes_exact`), refuted by nothing with no decision (`Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted`), and so too for two moments of one history (`Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes`). For finite decided branching frames, configurations are alike exactly where alike to depth N − 1 within one frame (`alike_iff_alikeTo_classes`, exact by `EndOfPath.classes_exact`) and N + N′ − 1 across two (`alike_iff_alikeTo_across`), sharpening the bound by the number of pairs, which is kept. The bounds connect: Fine and Wilf's N + N′ − 1 is Moore's bound for two systems read as one; within one world the configurations share their classes; for determined laws read through registrations, likeness to depth k is agreement for k + 1 steps (`alikeTo_registered_iff`), so a frame's extra step is where whether a move can be taken registers. Counting classes needs the values decided, only for the finitely many pairs; the bound 2N − 1 needs none. Not shown: exactness of N + N′ − 1 between two frames, and whether N − 1 holds with no decision. Scratch build: Refinement 11 theorems, Identification 56, Likeness 137, empty axiom reports; the consolidated receipt follows the integrator's run. Not yet independently reviewed.

**Periphery proofs joined to the spine, integration I3c (15 October 2026).** Continuing column I, section 129 states four more records on the spine: the shared stock, finite continuation plans, joint plans and learned-procedure transmission. Their periphery modules use Std's tactics or Mathlib, so the instances are written in periphery modules, each with its own checker, which the core does not import. The measure goes from 179 to 183 stated on the spine and from 10 to 6 outside.
- **Keeping a guard through what is registered (Becoming.Keeping, no premise).** A move is usable from a class of configurations where it is allowed and enabled at each of them, and what its step registers narrows the class (`Seen`, which is `InquirySufficiency.After` where registrations are listed). A class is kept for `n` steps where the guard holds throughout and some usable move leaves, whatever is registered, a class kept one step fewer (`KeptFor`). A plan whose later moves follow what was registered keeps the class for its length. Where registrations are listed, every kept class has such a plan (`keptFor_iff_plan`). For arbitrary registrations, kept classes having plans in every process is exactly choice over the registrations (`plans_iff_choice`). Choice is a named hypothesis (`ChoiceOver`), and the periphery's `choose` sits exactly there. A certificate of `Viability` with a move usable throughout keeps every class within it for every horizon. Registering a hidden bit can make the difference between keeping and losing (`Matching`). Two parts' plans run together keep both guards where joint steps project onto the parts and the paired moves are usable throughout (`Plan.zip_keeps`), and every keeping joint plan has its paired moves usable throughout.
- **Instances.**
  - `ContinuationAdequacy.viable` is `KeptFor` with the configuration reached registered, and plans translate both ways. So `viable_iff_plan` follows from the core with classical choice, and with none for listed observations. `JointContinuation`'s two composition theorems follow from `Plan.zip_keeps` and `Plan.compatible_of_zip_keeps`.
  - `CorrectionDependence`'s selected totals are masses on the first draws, so its law of the shared stock is `every_event_within_iff`; every declaration has an empty axiom report.
  - In `LearnedProcedureTransmission`, the capacity is the longest lineage `Copying.lineage_all_iff` releases from one pool and support. Every course of exposures and reconstructions conserves material and support (`Stock.trace_balance`). Faithful reconstruction is Price's counting form with nothing raised or lowered (`price`): two of three successors carry the responsive procedure where one of two parents did, the counts set by the support each family's actual task success left.
- **Remaining.** Six records stay outside: five constructions, tools or documentation records, which go with I4 and await Ren, and one awaiting column E.

**Moore's bound needs no decision, P83d (15 October 2026).** The question section 128 left open, whether N − 1 holds with no decision, under Ren's “keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them” of 12 October and “offer it to them, keep proving” of 15 October. It holds, with no premise. Section 130 decides positions instead of values. The law is read on the positions of the list, whose equality in Nat is decided (`Law.orbit_memberAt`, finitely many existences chosen together, no axiom of choice). The record's N − 1 agreements are joined pair by pair into a labelling of positions whose labels have one value each (`Law.merge`, `Law.joinOrbits_sound`). Moore's bound counted by classes (`Law.sameFuture_iff_classes`) then holds for the labelling and carries over to the values. So two members of a list of N members closed under a determined law have the same registered future exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps (`Law.sameFuture_iff_within`), and two moments of a history with at most N states are one state exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps (`Identification.sameAhead_iff_within`), both with no premise. The earlier line that the shorter bound needs a decision and 2N − 1 does not is withdrawn: neither needs one. Hopcroft and Karp (1971) also merge state pairs with union-find; here only the recorded pairs are merged, then the counting bound applies. Branching frames still need `FiniteDecided`. Edits `Becoming.Identification` only; scratch build: 69 theorems, 86 declarations, empty axiom reports; the core receipt follows the integrator's run. Not yet independently reviewed.

**Where a move is formed (P109, 15 October 2026).** The records of P69 and P80 asked when a move is formed within the unfolding rather than supplied from outside, and when it is the part's own; Ren had agreed that “there are no two realities” (12 October, [source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-12-no-two-realities.md)) and asked to “finish all” (14 October). Section 131 adds one core module, `Becoming.Coupling` (51 theorems, no axiom, no premise beyond what each law names), stated on the shared `Learning.Lumped` and `Readout.Reading`.
- **One move, two sides.** A part and the rest are coupled by one move formed within the whole (`coupled`: the synchronized product with the move read off the joint configuration, P69's `closedBy` of the product), so what the part does is what the rest undergoes. The move is the part's exactly where it is a policy of the part, the rest's exactly where it is a policy of the rest, and both only where it is the same everywhere; a move formed by their relation is formed by neither alone (`partForms_iff`, `partForms_and_restForms_iff`, `Parity.neither_alone`). An own move closes the part and is the rest's input (`PartForms.goAlike`, `Run.rest_driven_by_part`); closed is not own (`TwoClocks.closed_not_own`).
- **No move needs supplying from outside the whole.** Every run of a labelled process is the part's course in a whole whose rest, a clock, forms its moves (`Run.withClock`), the counterpart for moves of `World.withRest`. A rest held by a list, under a law that is a function, forms exactly the moves that repeat from some step (`Run.moves_lasso_of_rest_held`, `Run.withLasso`), so moves that never settle into a cycle need a former that no list holds.
- **What the record fixes.** Along a course the moves read as formed through the configurations exactly where some relation giving at most one move at each configuration gives them, with no decision (`lumped_iff_singleValued`); on a finite stretch with equality decided, no policy gives them exactly where a configuration recurs with the move varied (`no_policy_upto_iff`). Where nothing recurs every reading fits: a part keeping its history reads every move as its own (`Run.keepHistory_formed`), and one course is admitted by the part's law of the move and by the rest's (`TwoClocks.one_course_two_laws`), so, like requirement in `Becoming.Reading`, whose move it is belongs to the law. Experiment needs return (P53); attribution needs recurrence with variation.
- **Readings (the AI's, pending Ren).** Acting and undergoing are one move read from its two sides; an input is the rest's configuration, and a label from outside is a move whose forming the representation leaves out; whose move it is, is a claim about courses not taken; reading more, more is one's own; closed is not own; novelty in what is done needs openness or growth.

**Distinguishing: the tests are a bounded record, and the depth across two frames is exact, P83e (15 October 2026).** Two open items, under Ren's “keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them” of 12 October and “offer it to them, keep proving” of 15 October: the instance theorem to `alike_iff_sameTests` (identification-where-bounded) and the exactness of N + N′ − 1 between two branching frames (tests-fix-likeness-where-determined). Section 132 adds the core module `Becoming.Distinguishing`, the first to import both `Identification` and `Likeness`; no existing module changes. Under a determined law read through a registration, in a world a list of N configurations holds, two configurations pass the same tests exactly where their registered futures agree for N − 1 steps (`Law.sameTests_iff_within`). Across two worlds of N and N′ configurations the length is N + N′ − 1 (`Law.sameTests_iff_below_across`). Infinitely many tests are fixed by finitely many registered values. Where each configuration's single move is named by what is registered there (`Law.labelled`), likeness to depth k is agreement for k steps (`Law.alikeTo_labelled_iff`). Every history with at most N states is the course of a law on N configurations (`Law.realized_within`). So the two courses of `Identification.bounded_agree_exact` give, for every N and N′, finite decided frames of N and N′ configurations alike to depth N + N′ − 2 and not alike (`labelled_across_exact`), and registered worlds agreeing for N + N′ − 2 steps that do not pass the same tests (`registered_across_exact`). One pair of courses thus witnesses three exactness results: Fine and Wilf's N + N′ − 1, the length of the tests across two worlds, and the depth across two branching frames. Not constructed: exactness of N − 1 for the tests of one world wholly held by N configurations. Scratch build: 10 theorems, 11 declarations, empty axiom reports. Not yet independently reviewed.

**The rest step needs no bound: 2N − 1 for every learner, and the bound buys only silence, P83f (15 October 2026).** This answers identification-where-bounded's open item “the optimal rest step of the learner not given the bound”, under Ren's “keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them” of 12 October. Section 133 adds the learner by the least bound (`leastBound`). It is given no bound, and claims by the first lasso hypothesis the record bears out within the least bound within which one is. On every history with at most N states it is right at every step from 2N − 1 on, for every N (`leastBound_exact`), because what it finds lies within the true bound and Fine and Wilf's bound makes it the law. Given two values, no learner, given the bound or not, is right at step 2N − 2 on every such history (`rest_earliest`, from `record_short_twice`). So 2N − 1 is the optimal rest step, and being given the bound does not move it. What the bound buys is silence: no learner right at step 1 on every one-state history is refuted nowhere on every two-state history (`rest_without_bound_refuted`), whereas the learner given the bound stays silent and is refuted nowhere. The record's statement is revised accordingly (the former statement kept in its history). The learner by refutation's own exact step stays open; `learner_rests` is kept. Reading (the AI's): deriving needs the bound to hold, not to be known. Edits `Becoming.Identification` only; scratch build: 74 theorems, 94 declarations, empty axiom reports. Not yet independently reviewed.

**Periphery proofs joined to the spine, integration I3d (15 October 2026).** Continuing column I, section 134 joins the last six records whose main proof lay outside the spine run: material preparation, grown fragmentation, the prior risk certificate, binding-preserving substitution, renewing and consuming formation, and the alignment direction. Section 129 had set five of them aside as constructions, tools or documentation; read again, each main theorem has the shape of a general law, which the core lacked in five cases. I3d adds a section of laws to each of four existing core modules and one to the bridge, and writes four periphery instance modules, each with its own checker, which the core does not import. The measure goes from 184 to 190 stated on the spine and from 5 to 0 outside: no record's main proof now lies outside the spine run.
- **Core laws, no premise.**
  - **Judging a listed family through a reduction** (`Becoming.Readout`). A judge reading only the reduced value gives the observable at every member exactly where the observable goes alike across what the reduction merges (`judges_iff_lumpedOn`). The judge answers with the first listed member of each reduced value, so no choice is used. Where the reduction merges two members the observable tells apart, no judge exists (`no_judge_of_merged`).
  - **Readings through parts** (`Becoming.Readout`). Where every reading reads only through the parts and each part is read directly by some reading, two configurations agree under every reading exactly where they agree at every part (`agree_iff_parts`). So a replacement agrees with the original under every reading exactly where it supplies every part (`supplied_agree_iff_parts`).
  - **Emptying the pool** (`Becoming.Copying`). Copying a word from a pool leaves it empty exactly where the pool holds each token as often as the word uses it and the support covers the draws (`empties_iff`).
  - **A level drawn on and not replenished** (`Becoming.Stock`). Where each step's draw and what then stands are at most what stood before, everything drawn along a course is at most the starting level (`trace_falls`). Where moreover every step from a positive level draws something, a course as long as that level ends at nothing (`exhausted_within`).
  - **Certified closures** (`Becoming.Feedback`). A region is a formation's closure exactly where it holds the formation, is closed under the relation and lies within the closure (`closure_iff_certified`). A closed region holding one formation and not another separates them (`not_within_of_closed`).
  - **Protection-first comparisons** (bridge, empty axiom reports). Every `PracticalJudgment.Better` is `BetterAt` on the frame of its options, with the same frontier (`Judgment.better_iff_betterAt`, `Judgment.frontier_iff`).
- **Instances.**
  - **Material preparation** (`PreparationCorrespondence`). Routing is copying with a unit draw per attachment, so its exact completion with an empty pool is `Copying.empties_iff`.
  - **Grown fragmentation** (`PreparationCorrespondence`). A cut's certified components are closures, and a certified cut separates its ends. Matched composition with different cut returns is `no_judge_of_merged`.
  - **The prior risk certificate** (`JudgingCorrespondence`). The endpoint test is `Judges` on the admitted realizations, and its impossibility is `no_judge_of_merged`.
  - **Renewing and consuming formation** (`RenewingCorrespondence`). Formation beyond the current renewal rate draws on a level that is not replenished. So its bound and its end are `Stock.trace_falls` and `Stock.exhausted_within`, for every share, shared formation included.
  - **Binding-preserving substitution** (`SubstitutionCorrespondence`). Evaluation reads only through positions. With the periphery's substitution lemma, its exact position criterion is `supplied_agree_iff_parts`. The core supplies the criterion, not the lemma.
  - **The alignment direction** (bridge). Its comparison of plans and its frontier are `BetterAt`'s (`alignment_better_iff_betterAt`, `alignment_frontier_iff`). Its claims, Ren's words and the fold of G0 are unchanged: `BetterAt` states J1/J2, and G0 is neither used nor asserted. Demand-indexed coverage has no exact counterpart on the spine and stays in the periphery.
- **Remaining.** Column I's remaining step is I4, the classification of about 500 modules, which awaits Ren.

**Records in an inherited module joined to the spine, integration I3e (15 October 2026).** Continuing column I, section 135 takes two of the seven records whose main proof lay in an inherited module: organizational formation from generative comparison and practical judgment under G0/J. The main theorem of each is that a finite menu has an undominated choice, or follows from it. The periphery proves that classically (`PracticalJudgment.finite_frontier` uses `classical`), and the core had no such law. I3e adds a section of laws to the existing core module Becoming.Decidedness that says exactly what the law needs. It adds three theorems to the bridge and writes one periphery instance module with its own checker, which the core does not import. For practical judgment only references, aliases and history change: its claims, Ren's words and the fold of G0 are unchanged. The measure goes from 190 to 192 stated on the spine and from 7 to 5 in an inherited module.
- **Core laws, no premise** (`Becoming.Decidedness`).
  - **Existence.** A proposition is weakly decided where it fails or its failure is refuted (`WeaklyDecided`, `¬ p ∨ ¬ ¬ p`). A nonempty listed menu has an undominated member where the comparison is irreflexive, transitive and weakly decided on it (`exists_undominated`). The member is found by one pass along the list, using no choice and no excluded middle.
  - **What undominated members have.** Where every member lacking a property is bettered by some member, an undominated member cannot lack it (`Undominated.not_not_has`, no decidedness), and has it where the property is decided (`undominated_has`). With comparison and property decided, this holds exactly where every member lacking the property is bettered (`undominated_has_iff`).
- **Two boundaries.** Asked of every relation, the existence law needs exactly weak excluded middle (`exists_undominated_iff_weakly`). The witness is `Opposed p` on two members: `true` betters `false` exactly where `p` holds, and `false` betters `true` exactly where `p` fails. Asked of every menu, relation and property, dropping the property's decidedness is exactly excluded middle (`undominated_has_iff_em`). Both join the boundary theorems of the decidability inventory.
- **Bridge** (empty axiom reports). On an exact listed menu, the frontier of `PracticalJudgment` is the undominated members (`Judgment.frontier_iff_undominated`). **The learner by refutation rests at a cubic step, and N − 1 is exact for the tests within one world, P83g (15 October 2026).** The two minor open items of identification-where-bounded and tests-fix-likeness-where-determined, under Ren's “let's finish Still open, all minor” of 15 October. Section 136 adds a section to `Becoming.Identification` and one theorem to `Becoming.Distinguishing`; declarations are only added, with no axiom and no premise. On the two-valued negation along a cycle of N = 2m + 3 places (`oddCycle`), which cannot close around an odd cycle and breaks once in every turn, a history with at most N states, the learner by refutation over the lasso hypotheses is refuted at step (N³ − N)/4 (`learner_refuted_late`). From the second turn on, every even shift it holds runs to the end of a turn and is refuted at the start of the next, and every odd shift is refuted within the turn, so each of the (N² − 1)/4 even shifts before the period N costs a whole turn. A step from which it is right on every two-valued history with at most N states therefore comes after (N³ − N)/4 (`learner_rest_cubic`): with `learner_rests` its rest step is cubic in N, while the learner by the least bound rests from 2N − 1 (section 133). The constant is not proved. Exhaustive search over histories with at most N states (two values, N ≤ 17; three, N ≤ 9) finds the worst rest step (N³ − N)/4 + 3 for odd N ≥ 3, attained by the same negation started elsewhere; that is a computation, not a proof. Within one world the tests' N − 1 is exact for every N ≥ 2: on Fin N, along the path to a last place that stays, registering only whether the last is reached, the first two places agree for N − 2 steps and do not pass the same tests (`registered_within_exact`). Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): deriving does not need the bound known, but how the record is read sets when; refuting one hypothesis at a time derives the law a cubic order later than reading by the simplest law.

**The least registration with any number of conditions (P113, 15 October 2026).** The record of P80 asked whether, with infinitely many conditions, sensitivity remains the least registration, or a counterexample; `Becoming.Counterfactual` listed it as not derived, under Ren's goal of 12 October, “move towards 100%” ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-12-move-towards-100.md)). Section 137 adds one core module, `Becoming.Sensitivity` (47 theorems, no axiom, no premise beyond what each law names), on Counterfactual's definitions.
- **Reading finitely many conditions.** A law reads finitely many conditions where at every step, for every formation and under every history, what it exchanges is fixed by the levels of some list of conditions, the list possibly depending on the history (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely`): pointwise continuity on histories. Such a law reads what has stood; with finitely many conditions every law of what has stood does; with infinitely many a law can read two conditions under each history and within no one list under all (`Pointer.no_list`).
- **Sensitivity is the least registration, with any number of conditions.** Such a law reads through what it is sensitive to, and every registration it reads through holds every condition it is sensitive to (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.through_sensitive`, `ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.least_registration`); the comparison as the dynamics give holds with any number of conditions (`comparison_through_sensitivity_of_readsFinitely`), Counterfactual's finite case being an instance. A law reading finitely many conditions and sensitive to none gives alike everywhere (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.alike_of_insensitive`): what depends on the whole depends on some part.
- **The tail.** The condition cannot be dropped: given a decision of whether levels vanish from some condition on, the tail law exchanges its indicator; it reads what has stood, is sensitive to no condition and still differs (`tailLaw_not_sensitive`, `tailLaw_differs`), and the registrations it reads through, from any condition on, have no least one (`tailLaw_no_least_registration`).
- **Every counterexample gives omniscience.** With the conditions numbered by the natural numbers, a law of what has stood giving differently under two histories that agree on what it is sensitive to gives the weak limited principle of omniscience (`wlpo_of_not_through_sensitive`, `WLPO`), as does every law insensitive to every condition that still differs (`wlpo_of_insensitive_differs`), by mixing the two histories along a Boolean sequence; the decision the tail law takes gives the limited principle itself (`lpo_of_vanish_decided`). So no counterexample can be exhibited in the core, and the existence of one lies between `WLPO` and that decision.
- **Readings (the AI's).** Registration is sensitivity: a formation registers what its own exchange can be changed by, one condition at a time. What depends on the whole and on no part of it is a tail, like eventual vanishing or a long-run average, the counterpart without probability of Kolmogorov's tail events; that every law reads finitely many conditions would be Brouwer's continuity principle, which refutes `WLPO`, and which the core neither states nor refutes. Not stated: a measure of sensitivity, and exactly where between `WLPO` and the decision of vanishing a counterexample lies. Scratch build on main `108e278e`: 47 theorems, 58 declarations, empty axiom reports; the decidability inventory classifies every new row. Not yet independently reviewed.

**Identification where runs part, and typicality by counting (P116, 16 October 2026).** Ren's fourth message of 15 October: “not sure what's the reading 1, but reality is always situational … "What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing … if my earlier words are unreasonable, please keep note, not follow blindly” ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-15-situational-and-the-whole-core.md)). The identification line is stated for determined laws; what it did not reach was the registration's limit, already exact in `Becoming.Learnable` (section 119, cited, not reproved), and worlds that branch or carry weights. Section 140 adds two core modules, with no axiom and no premise beyond what each law names.
- **`Becoming.Parting` (18 theorems).** Two runs part at a step where they register the same before it and differ at it; at a parting no learner, whatever it is given, the world included, is right on both (`not_right_on_both`). Not parting is kept along runs (`Unparted.along`, by joining runs at a step); so on a run from an unparted configuration held by N configurations the registered course has at most N states, and the learner by the least bound is right from N + N − 1 on (`course_statesBelow`, `leastBound_right`), exact for processes as for laws (`rest_earliest_runs`). A determined process with one move parts nowhere; so does a branching that does not show in what is registered. Under free branching every course is a run's course: after every record two runs part, every learner has a run on which it is never right, and a run on two configurations has a course with no bound on its states (`free_parts_after`, `free_never_right`, `free_unbounded`).
- **`Becoming.Typicality` (32 theorems).** With two values counted by natural weights p and q, the weighted squared deviations (q·a − p·b)² of the courses of n steps add up exactly to n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ (`spread`), so the courses deviating by at least d weigh, times d, at most that (`typical`): the counting form of the weak law of large numbers, with no premise. The weights are `Becoming.Weighted`'s counting weights of free branching (`sum_courses_weight`). That the course which happens is typical is not derived: every course is a run.
- **Notes on Ren's words (the AI's).** “The full truth can be derived, situationally” holds for what is registered, as far as runs do not part; at a parting the next value is fixed by nothing registered before it, not even for a knower of the world, and weights show only through typical courses, typicality not being derived. “Reality is always situational” agrees with the core if it means every registration is within a context; if it means every situation has a bound on its states, it is a substantive premise that no axiom-free derivation gives, since the core has worlds with no bound. The core covers every world in that its laws are stated for every process; it does not derive every fact, and at partings it derives exactly what cannot be fixed. Ren did not adopt reading 1 (“situationally means the bound”); it stays the AI's reading with these qualifications.
- **Boundaries.** The learner reads configurations, not moves; the rest step where runs part only before some step, and the exact converse with a learner given the world, are not stated; typicality is stated for two values with Chebyshev's bound only. Scratch build on main b34b8027 (after P114): empty axiom reports, the root and its 113-module core closure compiled. Not yet independently reviewed.

**How much difference arrives (P115, 16 October 2026).** The record of P80 asked for a measure of how much difference arrives, which `Becoming.Counterfactual` listed as not derived, as did five more records (P109's "a measure of coupling", P113's "a measure of sensitivity", feedback-and-reach, comparison-where-the-rest-responds and levels-of-closure) and the chapter's §8, under Ren's goal of 12 October, “move towards 100%” ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-12-move-towards-100.md)). Section 141 adds one core module, `Becoming.Propagation` (78 theorems, no axiom, no premise beyond what each law names), on Counterfactual's definitions.
- **Difference arrives as exchanged difference.** In two balanced flows the difference of a condition's levels changes across a step by exactly the difference given less the difference taken (`levels_step_exact`), so a gap across a step is at most the gap before with the gaps of every exchange (`gap_step`).
- **Coupling strength, the measure of sensitivity.** An exchange is coupled to a level with strength at most `k` where, under two histories differing in that level only, it differs by at most `k` times that level's gap (`ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin`, a coordinate-wise Lipschitz bound). For a law of what has stood, strength zero is insensitivity (`ExchangeLaw.insensitiveAt_iff_strength_zero`); strengths add up over levels changed one at a time (`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_strengths`), bounding a part's share of a move (`ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares`); a law giving the square of a level has no finite strength (`Propagation.Square.not_respondsWithin`).
- **The carried amount, attained.** Where the rest follows such a law, every gap is at most the carried amount, the course the carrying law generates by Counterfactual's generation from the starting gaps and the part's gaps (`gap_le_carried`); the carrying law has those strengths and attains it (`carried_attained`), so the carried amount is the most difference that can arrive (`most_difference_arrives`, an equivalence).
- **Where it goes.** It is positive exactly along a route in time of positive strengths (`carried_pos_iff`), on routes of `TimedResponse.Spread` where the strengths are registered (`Conveyed.spread`); where no route reaches, the levels agree. Carried amounts add (`carried_add`).
- **Witnesses.** A unit given once and relayed at twice its level arrives as 2t by step t + 1, with no loop, since levels hold what they are given (`Propagation.Chain.keeps_arriving`); a loop of strength one gives 2^t (`Propagation.Loop.runaway`).
- **Readings (the AI's).** The coupling strength is the measure sensitivity lacked; how much difference arrives is itself a course of the one unfolding; a held difference keeps arriving; how entangled a whole is reads as how strongly its exchanges are coupled to each other's levels. Not derived: the strengths themselves (supplied bounds, no least one stated), a general theory of loops, infinitely many conditions, real amounts and continuous time. In systems terms the strengths are incremental gains and the carried amount their comparison system, here attained. The name "coupling strength" follows levels-of-closure, leaving "gain" to P111. Scratch build on main `416ff6b0`: 78 theorems, 97 declarations, empty axiom reports; the decidability inventory classifies every new row. Not yet independently reviewed.

**Every origin passes the gate, integration I4b item 1 (16 October 2026).** Ren chose “Closest gaps first” on the I4 classification table ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-16-i4-decisions.md)). The table read LivingOrganization as a join candidate: over any reaction network, a pool present at the end was present initially or came in at an entry step. Becoming.Gated stated only quantities the ungated steps keep in both directions; the one-directional trace law was unstated (section 139). This section states it, with Gated's earlier law as its case.
- **Preserved and reflected** (`Becoming.Gated`, no premise; 4 → 13 theorems).
  - The ungated steps preserve p where it holding before a step gives it after (`PreservedBy`), and reflect p where it holding after gives it before (`ReflectedBy`).
  - Keeping a quantity is preserving every value of it, and equally reflecting every value (`keptBy_iff_preserved`, `keptBy_iff_reflected`).
  - Along courses these hold exactly as along steps (`preserved_along_iff`, `reflected_along`).
- **Leaving passes the gate.** Where the ungated steps preserve p, a course from where p holds to where it fails contains a gated move (`leaving_passes_gate`). `change_passes_gate` is its case p := (q equals its starting value).
- **Every origin passes the gate.** Where the ungated steps reflect p, a course ending where p holds either started where it held, or splits into a prefix, a gated step after which p holds, and the rest (`origin`). The proof splits only on the gate, which is already decided; p is not decided.
- **Boundary.** With the gate a proposition, the law holds wherever every gate holds or fails (`origin_of_decides`). Asked of every process, it is exactly double-negation elimination (`origin_of_propositions_iff`).
  - The witness is one move from `false` to `true`, with p holding at `true` and the gate Q. The move reflects p exactly where Q cannot fail, and the law then gives Q.
  - So the law needs exactly a decided gate.
- **LivingOrganization** (`LivingOrganizationCorrespondence`, periphery, with its own checker).
  - The gate is the recipes entering the pool (`entryGate`). Every other step reflects pool presence (`presence_reflected`).
  - So `trace_pool_origin` follows from `Gated.origin` (`trace_pool_origin_by_core`), which adds that the pool is present right after the entry step (`entry_then_present`). The periphery theorem decided the pool; the core law does not.
  - Where every admitted recipe is closed, there is no gate, and `reflected_along` keeps an empty pool empty (`empty_pool_preserved_by_core`).
  - Axiom reports: only propext and Quot.sound, from LivingOrganization's own arithmetic and list tactics. The core's new declarations have empty reports.
- **Decidability inventory.** `origin_of_decides` splits on each gate: proof-only theorems go 223 → 224. `origin_of_propositions_iff` joins the boundary theorems.
- **Record.** The new record every-origin-passes-the-gate reuses organizational-rule-inheritance's `KeptBy`.
- **Not stated.** Where p is decided, the first gated step at which p comes to hold could be located as in `change_located`; this section does not state it.
- **Boundary and reading.** The gate locates where change or origin can enter; it does not say a gated move changes anything. The recipes keep LivingOrganization's scope. The reading, which is the AI's and pending Ren: reflecting is "present after only if present before", so an organization's pool was there already or came in through an entry.
